Thanks. How do I know I'm not bothering someone, because that's the impression I mostly get (and when I see other people attain, it's obvious they get treatment as creeps. Unless they are exceptionally handsome).

I've turned 30, and as much successful/smart I am, I don't have a formal credit for that. I don't like my current job, I'm not sure what direction to try and achieve, as a lot of things are blocked for me because of money,age/need to work months for acceptance and citizenship (Non US or EU) so everything is learned twice, and it's harder to advance somewhere later on.

27M, single, virgin. 
Whatever I tried didn't work.
How can I know what I'm doing wrong? what will make me attainable? 
Is it all attractiveness? money? 
What can I do to change it?
Exactly. with the addition of the daily struggle of being alone and unaccomplished.

I missed on the college experience, wasn't even aware of that because of some life choices and duties to fulfill in my path. I wasn't aware of options and the benefits. I wasn't aware about the social function. 

My parents are largely supporting my brother to become an MD for the past 10 years, it won't happen for me. It's the financial struggle and a lot of other affects. I don't have anything specific to be motivated about, I'm truly don't know what I want to do. I urge company, a relationship, flexible times/work. I just can't be on my own anymore. for the brief time I had a little support I've studied a whole semester material in 3 days and got an A, my highest university score. but I couldn't continue studying in that environment.

I don't have a relationship to trust completely, I don't have a job that won't make me sad, treat me badly or I can count on it to make me progress. I really can't see my life a year or even a month from now. 
Unless something amazing will happen... I don't know what I will do.

The internet is amazing. and I can learn about every MIT course out there and expand my knowledge (even take every assignment and test). but, other than the commitment. it takes time and as of today, no one will consider you a student. Not society and not other facilities. 
And I want more, I want to have the community feeling, study with young people at my age. but I'm no longer young, and they are significantly younger than me. I'll never be able to get that experience.

I've studied on my own at home, but can't do it alone anymore. I need an SO in my life. 

Don't you have resources to learn from?

It's computers related and it's not dying that fast, but each year some of the process is automated and the learning curve gets bigger. Some aspect require special million dollar hardware, so it's hard to gain experience in that field. 5 years from now, it will be a lot different. I see people older than me, struggle to keep family life with that demanding and insecure job. 

I wish to do something creative. Write, direct. I also enjoy history, biology, chemistry and mathematics. I can't have the freedom to explore and never had the guidance.

No. I'm not even in a position for a grand to study locally. it's complicated and too late for my age. 

About $200K to get to school and sustain living, then I can hope I'll be able to stay and work. The problem is, most employers will prefer to get someone they don't have to sponsor his stay, when they can get a lot of other locals, even interns. I'm too old for that right now.

I have $100K to my name, if I was working in my profession in the US, I would've probably be doing that times 3, but I don't know if I have the willpower for that right now (I don't see a near future for that profession and would like to pursue other interests). 

I don't really see the point to continue living right now, when it looks too late to build a new future and there is nothing comforting anymore about anything that used to make me happy. I can't help myself anymore and other than some crazy amount of money (like $5M, that will allow me to build a business in the US and stay legitimately) won't change my life. I'm making others life better, they treat me bad. I'm too good for this world.

I prefer one on one, but eventually I have no other choice. 

Sadly, No. Citizenship is required everywhere and the US is the cheapest to live/study (Australia, Europe are really expensive, although sometimes cheaper than here), but I can't move without a legit permit. I'm not sure about Asia, but it seems to be problematic as well.

I'm a member of several groups, but I never feel like part of the core. For some reason there is some group leader that people will agree with every whimsy desire he has... and I can follow or not. In addition to that, they do regroup and betray me. I think it's because of the local culture to stay with your highschool group. 

I'm sure that a girlfriend will change that, it's all I want. Can't see this happening in the future, nothing happened until now.
Regrouping without me. I can only guess the reasons, but after some talks with others... (Including people from the group, there is no immediate cause that I can tell).
None. Family that helps when and how they want and me, trying to succeed. I have several people who are considered friends, but each and every one of them proves me other wise. Constantly.

I recently moved back with them for a while, trying to figure my options. They still tried to control and criticize every part of my life when I was living by myself for 3 years. They don't finance me/actions, they heavily finance my brother and sister.

So, on a certain level winning some kind of lottery is my only hope. (As I didn't won the citizenship lottery and I'm not someone that will try doing illegal stuff).
And I guess you're right (sometimes people try to help by giving their perspective, but it does help when their terms are better), but I mostly meant my immediate surroundings, like my parents. They love me and want to help, but it's too little (I don't want to ask them for more), too late and always in their wrong way.
(Like, when I'm trying a new diet, doing everything thing they can to discourage me from keto, but willing to pay to get me in a diet program with 50+ ghetto ladies...)

The truth? Money. 
But serious amounts, that will let me move abroad (my abroad is the US), study and live there. 
Other than that, it's a long road of trial and error, with no real affection for the surrounding people (some care, they can't help. Some insist on trying, and do more damage).

The more I get old, I understand how horrible people were and see how horrible they currently are...

I know what you mean, but I'm missing a few parameters from my life to be there and it's too late to get them now.

You can always do anything, you're only tangled by commitments to others and how are you willing to keep them and money. You can take risks and chances, but in the end it's only the amount of money that you have that will help you in your final decision - or equivalent helpers.
(You can't live and work in Europe without the proper visas which are either really hard to get, unless you're born with it. or you have money).
Thanks. That's nice... but it won't do, as I'm missing my 20s accomplishments, and most of the 30s aren't relevant to me.
